<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Found 2026-11-04 by the performance and delivery seats after a bounce; all three sites date from the first public release (03ab38e). The PA (pij-watchful-badger) runs `pij anomalies --json` unscoped every round, as skill invariant 12 says, so every round paid the full cost. The fix (kestrel's proposal on #119): node show and the spine-events cursor use `Spine::newest()` (a MAX(seq) rowid seek); `spine events --since` reads with `tail_page` under a default and maximum `--limit` and returns the next cursor, and `--peer` seeks `spine_by_seat`; anomalies builds its view from per-seat indexed reads (`latest_matching`, `all_matching` on `spine_by_seat_kind`, and a small `Spine::latest(seat)`), as `pa_watchdog::stale_cards` already does, so cost scales with seats x kinds, not with history.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- One `pij anomalies` call costs a few MB and milliseconds, not GB and seconds, at today's spine size.
- The three verbs give the same answers as before.
- No other spine read on a supervisor's routine path is unbounded.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Deleting the 3.59M junk `bg.lost` rows: an operator decision, out of scope.
- Spine retention or compaction.
- Changing what anomalies reports.

<a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

From #119 (2026-11-04): AnomalyService::list at crates/daemon/src/http/anomalies.rs:67 calls tail(None, Seq(0)) = SELECT ... FROM spine_events WHERE seq > 0 ORDER BY seq with fetch_all and no limit; with 4.18M rows (about 1.55 GB of payload) one call read about 2.3 GB, took 7.5 s and peaked the daemon at 6.5 GB physical footprint (back to 95 MB after, RSS about 4.3 GB in empty malloc regions). node show (governance.rs:1630-1636) and spine events (governance.rs:1497-1503) call tail(None, 0).last() for a cursor; spine events --since reads unbounded and --peer filters after the read. The pattern to follow: pa_watchdog::stale_cards with latest_matching and all_matching on spine_by_seat_kind (plans 187 and 188). About 3.59M of the rows are junk bg.lost rows for one job.

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Never run the old unbounded calls against the prod daemon to compare; use a scratch store copy or synthetic spine.
- Builds scoped with -p and CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/fleet-190-community-writer/target (shared with the s04 coder; cargo serialises on its lock). Check `df -h /System/Volumes/Data` first; stop and tell pm-001 under 25 GB.
- No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`. No node_modules: TS proof is CI on the exact head.
- One push per review round; no pushes after a PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
